context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 20 verified all Android stability and Google Login fixes. Key changes from iteration 19: 1) ClusteredMapView is now lazy-loaded via require() ONLY on iOS instead of static import at top of file - this prevents the native clustering module from loading on Android which was causing ANR crashes. 2) All marker arrays are now memoized with safe* prefix and sliced to strict limits on Android (5 per category, 4 friends). 3) onRegionChangeComplete is debounced by 400ms on Android. 4) Google Auth startGoogleAuth now has warmUp/coolDown, try-catch around openAuthSessionAsync with Linking.openURL fallback, and showInRecents option. 5) google-callback.tsx tries multiple URL sources (initialUrl, window.location, fallback) for better Android deep link compatibility. 6) login.tsx handles null return from startGoogleAuth gracefully without showing error.
